text:
kevin_arch: RFC follow-up: I'm calling this the "handoff-proxy risk assessment". idea = single global control plane + tiny per-tenant proxy inside customer VPC that does ENI <-> route handoff, cert requests, and audit streaming. want to list risks and mitigations before spike.

maya_infra: risk: AWS API throttling when many proxies reconcile concurrently. mitigation: staggered backoff, central rate-limiter, and ability to batch route updates. also simulate 1k concurrent startups in spike.

ong_net: risk: route table count / fragmentation. mitigation: prefer aggregated prefixes + one ENI per-tenant-per-az; alternative: program a single catchall handoff route and let regional relay do per-tenant demux.

tess_sre: risk: lifecycle races (double-create, partial teardown). mitigation: use idempotent resource tags, leader-election for reconcilers, and a two-phase delete (mark -> sweep) to avoid flapping. add a reconciliation SLA and page on repeated failures.

rachel_prod: risk: onboarding friction. mitigation: provide a CFN/Terraform one-click that creates cross-account role and necessary tags. surface clear consent UI and a small checklist for compliance teams.

dave_sec: risk: increased attack surface inside customer accounts. mitigation: least-privilege cross-account role, allowlist of subnets/RTs, mandatory short-lived certs, and an audit requirement that proxies are read-only by default unless explicit write role is granted. require a security attestation checkbox.

kevin_arch: risk: audit continuity if proxy dies mid-flight. mitigation: proxies must stream signed events to customer-owned encrypted sink (S3/CloudWatch) before ack; we store signed digests centrally for traceability.

tess_sre: monitoring: metrics we need: proxy_boot_ms, reconcile_time_ms, route_apply_errors_total, cert_errors_total, proxy_crash_count. label by tenant/region/proxy_id. make a dashboard and set SLOs for reconcile_time (p95 < 10s).

ong_net: cost note: baseline per-proxy runtime + ENI charges + NAT if used. estimate: small Fargate task ~0.01 vCPU idle, 256MB mem, ENI costs vary by AZ. include cost per-tenant in pricing/recommendation docs.

maya_infra: operational policy: if proxy fails >3 times in 10m, flip tenant to regional-relay slow-path and notify ops + customer. have a manual override for on-prem customers.

kevin_arch: next steps: 1) run a 500-tenant startup simulation to measure API quotas and route scale, 2) draft minimal IAM policy and CFN template, 3) implement idempotent delete marker pattern in spike, 4) create runbook for failover to relay.

ops-bot: checklist created: HANDOFF-RISK-2024, assigned: tess_sre (runbook), ong_net (API sim), maya_infra (CFN), dave_sec (policy review), rachel_prod (customer comms).

kevin_arch: thanks. will open a short spike PR and drop the design doc link here when ready. follow-up sync Mon 9am.
